optimizer: AdamW betas0.9/0.999 eps1e-8 weight_decay0.01; no clipping
scheduler: MultiStepLR milestone600 gamma0.1 after optimizer; no additional decay
sampling: independent RandomState(seed), episode-balanced complete window cycles; no development selection
normalization: action/proprio existing drawer train-only statistics; latent new AE-C per-position mean + global raw std over all train windows/horizons/both appearances
clean_gate: separately for each method, all three seeds >=16/20
background_gap_candidate: all three seed background means < respective Clean AND equal-seed mean decrease >=0.10
statistics: state-cluster paired bootstrap preserves all backgrounds and seeds; does not cover training-seed/AE/task uncertainty
stop: numerical/CUDA/ECC failure stops and preserves; no silent retry, no valid failure rerun; no extension
initialization_matching: same pretrained VLA, LoRA, action queries, proprio and compatible head keys; RLA extra modules seed+1 in fork_rng; common saved RNG, shapes consume RNG differently during forward so exact trajectories not claimed
